function.name: download_file
function.description: Download a binary asset (image, font, icon, archive) from a URL and save it to a path inside the workspace. Use this — not fetch_url, not curl/wget — whenever the repository needs a real asset file: fetch_url returns text and corrupts binaries. The URL must point at the asset itself (ends in .png/.svg/.woff2/…), not at a page that shows it.

path.description: Destination file path, relative to the workspace root (e.g. public/images/google-play-badge.png)

url.description: Direct URL of the asset to download (must start with http:// or https://)

function.name: fetch_url
function.description: Fetch the content of a URL via HTTP GET. Returns the response body as text. For HTML pages, returns extracted readable text.

url.description: The full URL to fetch (must start with http:// or https://)
